A dated comment was added saying the text exists under other field names that the loader never reads. The exclusion itself was left unchanged.
plain_description.why: A false reason in the record could mislead readers or later analyses about why these models are missing.
plain_description.information: It keeps the record honest without changing any data or result. Result: done and merged. The six models stay excluded and the reasons are byte-unchanged. It does not show that those archives hold usable text beyond the first record checked. The wording in the thesis report is left to the author.
